$comment: USD per million tokens of the assistant's language models, counted as a workspace's AI usage when the endpoint reports no cost of its own (OpenAI does not; OpenRouter and fal.ai do). Keys are the model ids AI_ASSISTANT_MODEL takes; a router's "vendor/model" id also finds the bare one. AI_PRICES_FILE adds or replaces entries; AI_ASSISTANT_PRICES overrides one endpoint. Standard tier, short context (up to 272K input tokens for GPT-6).
